newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Profurn plans dual Namibia, Botswana listing.
newsitem.headline: Profurn plans dual Namibia, Botswana listing.

text.p: South African company Protea Furnishers Ltd said on Thursday that it planned to dual list on the Namibian and Botswanan stock exchanges with effect from August 6 and August 7 respectively.

"In order to demonstrate the group's commitment to the development of Namibia and Botswana and to ensure accessibility of its shares to the investors in those countries, Profurn shares will be dual listed on the Namibian and Botswana Stock Exchanges with effect from 6 August and 7 August respectively," the company said.
